messages:
jamie (Support): Hey team, multiple customers are hitting a spike of 5xx/gateway timeouts from the hosted API in eu-west-1 starting ~08:12 UTC. Customers report long tail timeouts during generation and some requests get 502/504. Ticket IDs: CS-4832, CS-4835.

lee (SRE): seeing it too. Alerting shows memcached cluster (cache-eu-a) high connection churn and increased latency. Dashboard: memcached avg latency -> 250ms, error rate -> 5%. Correlates with client-side prefix cache hits dropping.

ana (Eng - runtime): can you paste the memcached errors/log snippet? suspect prefix/KV cache timeouts are cascading into the inference runtime while it blocks on cache fetch.

jamie (Support): pasted from customer logs: ```
[2026-03-17T08:12:44Z] ERROR memcached: EOF reading from 10.23.5.12:11211
[2026-03-17T08:12:44Z] WARNING prefix-cache fetch timeout (200ms) key=prefix:abc123
[2026-03-17T08:12:45Z] ERROR runtime: model-gen request failed status=502 upstream_timeout
```

lee (SRE): internal memcached stats from the host: ```
STAT pid 12345
STAT get_hits 120234
STAT get_misses 80432
STAT cmd_get 200666
STAT curr_items 150000
STAT bytes 1234567890
STAT conn_yields 320
STAT rusage_system 12.34
STAT time_in_listen 0.01
``` Notable: conn_yields bumped and conn_total increased; looks like ephemeral connections due to health-check flapping.

ana (Eng - runtime): that matches a behavior we saw: when prefix cache backend has transient timeouts, the serving threads wait on KV lookup (synchronous) and that blocks token generation causing client-facing 5xx after request queueing. We should short-circuit cache fetch failures to async fallback.

mike (Customer Success): customers want ETA and workaround. Any temporary mitigation we can push? Some are losing production traffic.

lee (SRE): immediate mitigation options: 1) toggle prefix-caching=false for hosted eu-west-1 (global flag) to force runtime bypass of memcached and rely on model-level ops — low-risk short-term. 2) rate-limit memcached clients to reduce conn churn. 3) scale memcached pool or replace those nodes. I can flip the feature flag if eng approves.

ana (Eng - runtime): approve feature flag flip as emergency. We should also push a quick runtime patch to make cache fetches non-blocking with a 20ms in-memory fallback, but feature-flag toggle is fastest.

jamie (Support): action for CS: send customers a short note: "We're investigating transient KV cache failures causing timeouts; temporary mitigations being deployed (cache bypass)." I'll update tickets.

lee (SRE): starting feature-flag rollback of prefix-caching in eu-west-1 now. Rolling to 10% -> 50% -> 100% to observe. Deploy trace: deploy-ops#389.

cachebot: [automated] feature-flag toggle: prefix_cache.eu-west-1 -> disable (10% rollout) by lee at 08:14:02 UTC.

lee (SRE): 10% looks good, error rate down 30% on the sample. Proceeding to 50%.

cachebot: [automated] feature-flag toggle: prefix_cache.eu-west-1 -> disable (50% rollout) at 08:15:10 UTC.

ana (Eng - runtime): observing reductions in tail latency on traced requests that hit the bypass path. We should still follow up with a runtime fix to add bounded cache fetch timeouts and async fallback; file a PR and include a canary.

jamie (Support): replied to customers with interim note and ETA ~2h for full rollback + postmortem. Customers acknowledged.

lee (SRE): full disable done at 08:16:30 UTC. Post-action metrics: 5xx rate in eu-west-1 down to baseline. Opening an incident for root cause: INC-2026-032. Assigning to eng-runtime (ana).

ana (Eng - runtime): creating issue RUN-1421: investigation of memcached client behavior under connection churn, add non-blocking fetch path + fallback TTLs. Also will propose long-term: migrate prefix cache to redis cluster with connection pooling and health-aware routing.

mike (Customer Success): will follow up with affected customers and offer credits where SLA breached. Please add any repro steps so we can be transparent.

jamie (Support): repro steps captured for postmortem: 1) synthetic load with many short-lived connections to memcached host 2) observe conn churn and increased response time 3) send inference requests with heavy prefix cache access and verify 5xx spike. Attaching example curl to reproduce: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-2.0","input":"test"}'
```

lee (SRE): will also add healthcheck and connection pooling improvements on memcached side. For now, monitoring alert thresholds adjusted to catch conn_yields > 50 in 5m.

ana (Eng - runtime): thanks. I'll own the runbook updates: runtime will treat KV failures as cache misses and not block generation next time. Expect PRs in the morning.

jamie (Support): closing thread for now, will reopen if we see further regressions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
